scale_cues: Square white dinner plate about 26–27 cm across, filling most of the frame; a fork tine is visible at the top-left edge; I compared portion sizes against the plate area.
assumptions: The yellow block in the center is taken to be seasoned tofu; it could also be an egg frittata or polenta
The grain is taken to be a wild/brown rice blend, and the corn kernels mixed into it are counted in the grain item
The brown strands next to the beef are taken to be caramelized onions
The salad greens look glossy, so I assumed a light oil/vinaigrette dressing
The few small red bits (pepper or tomato) weigh under 5 g, so they are merged into the salad and grain items
